verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms Runpod serves an OpenAPI spec for its REST API v1 at https://rest.runpod.io/v1/openapi.json without needing an API key, and the docs describe that REST API as covering all compute resources. The probe finding 404s on docs.runpod.io candidate paths does not contradict this, since the spec lives on the API host rather than the docs host. Missing for 10: first-party documentation advertising the spec URL or download, independent corroboration beyond the single probe, and evidence about the spec's completeness or versioning (e.g., GraphQL schema coverage).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: https://rest.runpod.io/v1/openapi.json serves the REST API's OpenAPI spec keylessly
The Runpod REST API v1 provides programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources.
